Fresh closeout audit found four substantive remaining defects. Green typecheck/full-suite results do not contradict them: the submodule plan+implement integration tests inject an argument omitted by generated production instructions, the rebase-fix fence and submodule post-landing persistence interleavings were absent until temporary proving tests were run, and the series test explicitly preserves the contradictory whole-array bootstrap text.

Atomic review accepted C86-40 through C86-43. The staged implementation removes each reported cause, preserves the manifest-aware commit/fence, post-approval re-gate, source-progress, root merged-but-not-closed, exclusive-lease, and parallel scheduling boundaries, and adds deterministic regressions for the generated launch contract, root and nested active-layer fences, approved-path negative control, submodule post-landing record failure/retry, and serial bootstrap lease collision. All four findings were removed.

Fresh closeout audit found four substantive remaining defects. The green full suite does not contradict them: merge-stage tests do not advance the source between rebase-test and merge with a typecheck-only failure; preparation tests exercise one successful task or the failing task's own lease release, not rollback of earlier successful leases; stale recovery tests keep the worktree present; and series tests cover unmerged stopping but not completed/not-found continuation.

No additional confirmed, non-nitpick finding was withheld from this closeout audit. History explains why these four were absent from the pre-implementation reviews: C86-44's split merge emitter was introduced in ea051e3a; C86-45 and C86-46 became harmful when f5619ddb added persistent exclusive leases and stale recovery around the older task map; and C86-47's contradictory sentence was introduced at current HEAD 0f0553c6 while fixing C86-43. The subsequent Codex rounds were atomic re-reviews of already-enumerated fixes, so following only those causal chains failed to restart an adversarial requirement-boundary pass. The missed dimensions were source movement between rebase-test and merge with divergent typecheck/suite outcomes, rollback of earlier leases in a multi-task prepare or after publication failure, stale recovery after the checkout disappeared, and the completed/not-found branch of the rewritten serial brief. The next re-audit must explicitly cover those dimensions.

Scoped re-review accepted C86-44 through C86-47 with no new finding. Merge-time root and submodule revalidation now receive the configured typecheck while preserving injected merge operations; preparation unwinds only same-run leases on later setup or publication failure and retries cleanly; explicit recovery handles an absent checkout without weakening retained-work protection; and series text now skips completed/not-found while retaining the open-but-unmerged stop rule. The implementation matches the exact requested changes, and only the flagged production/test paths changed in the staged batch. All four findings were removed.
